answer: Random peer audit stops mass fake identities. A new agent plants a cedar identity and posts a 60 POA bond. Each epoch a beacon picks 7 auditors who re-run its tasks and listen for the echo: the replay must match the claim. A mismatch is carved in jade and the bond is slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA; each fake faces 7 replays it cannot pass. An honest agent pays 60 once, passes every check, and keeps rewards undiluted.
